changes.summary: New review artifacts: full-tree disposition, pack/invocation/execution recommendations, retained expertise, validation, limitations, five indexed questions, provider/maintenance limits, and promotion boundary.
Additive review-pointer comments carrying stable question IDs only; no instruction, rule, or behavioral changes.

disposition: retain as provider-managed frontend-craft skill with explicit cost, live-loop, and hook consent boundaries

execution.alternatives: read-only critique/audit without edits; code-led build skipping visualize.md by design; manual npx impeccable detect instead of the auto hook; bounded subagent delegation only where references name it (decision-comp fan-out, asset production, finish review) with degraded inline fallbacks otherwise
execution.recommended: in-session design work for build/refine/fix branches; bounded live-browser iteration only against the user's running dev server

invocation: Explicit /impeccable [command] [target] or a clearly implied design sub-command from the SKILL.md Commands table; bare /impeccable presents the context-aware routing menu and never auto-runs.
limitations: No live harness evaluation and no paid model or image calls; live-server was never launched.
No independent second-model review; authoring and verification by the same agent.
Full-tree reading is attested by checkpoint evidence, not proven by contract checks.
Source-mirror originals verified on this machine only; fresh-clone portability unresolved.
Five open questions and core/pack membership remain explicit human decisions.

questions.question: Should the gpt-image-2 API fallback spend the user's OpenAI credit on implicit session authority, or require explicit per-session consent?
questions.rationale: API spend on a user key is a cost decision no workflow convenience can imply.
questions.recommendation: Require explicit per-session consent before the first paid call.

questions.question: Should the design-detector hook auto-run after UI edits by default, or stay per-project opt-in?
questions.rationale: Automatic post-edit execution in user projects is a trust default the user should set.
questions.recommendation: Keep per-project opt-in with the existing off switch and env override.

questions.question: Who confirms the SKILL.md Apache-2.0 declaration and owns upstream maintenance, given no license file ships in the tree?
questions.rationale: A frontmatter license string without license bytes or known upstream settles no permission question.
questions.recommendation: Record the license owner and maintenance source before any redistribution or promotion.

questions.question: What trust boundary governs the live loopback server and its project writes for promotion?
questions.rationale: A localhost server that edits project files needs an explicit, reviewable boundary.
questions.recommendation: Keep the server loopback-bound and token-gated with writes scoped to the user's repo.

questions.question: Should this variant stay provider-managed or join an optional shared pack, and is it ever core?
questions.rationale: Six provider variants exist and pack policy keeps provider builds provider-owned; breadth of triggers is not core-membership evidence.
questions.recommendation: Provider-managed distribution; optional frontend-craft pack membership at most, never core.
